So let’s say the tests are culturally biased somehow, even though that assertion is retarded.

It absolutely is, because we can and do control for cultural bias in the items that are put into IQ tests. If you examine who gets which questions right in IQ tests, what you'll notice is that people in, say, the 40th percentile will get mostly the same set of questions right. If you look at what questions the people scoring in the 50th percentile get right, you'll notice it's largely the same set as as those in the 40th percentile, but they'll get a few more items correct, and it's largely the same set of additional items. If you look at which questions people placing in the 60th percentile get right... You get the idea.

This is how we determine whether an item on a test is "g loaded," which essentially means whether it tests for IQ or not. We look at whether the way examinees answer the item follows this trend. If answers given to an item more closely correlate with, say, an examinee's race or cultural background than their IQ, then we can deduce that it is not "g loaded," and does not measure IQ.
